segments.vv47:4.3: Tassā cattāri pupphāni, thūpaṃ abhihariṃ ahaṃ.
segments.vv47:5.3: Nāssa maggaṃ avekkhissaṃ, na taggamanasā [tadaggamanasā (sī.), tadaṅgamanasā (syā.)] satī.
segments.vv47:6.3: Tañcāhaṃ abhisañceyyaṃ, bhiyyo [bhīyo (sī. aṭṭha.)] nūna ito siyā.
segments.vv47:7.3: Pahāya mānusaṃ dehaṃ, tava sahabya [sahabyata (sī. syā.)] māgatā”ti.
segments.vv47:9.3: Appakampi kataṃ deyyaṃ, puññaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
segments.vv47:10.3: Tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake.
segments.vv47:12.1: “Tiṭṭhante nibbute cāpi, same citte samaṃ phalaṃ;
segments.vv47:13.3: Yattha kāraṃ karitvāna, saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā”ti.

lines: Pītapāsādasayaneti sabbasovaṇṇamayena pāsādena suvaṇṇaparikkhittehi sayanehi ca samannāgate.
Evaṃ sabbattha heṭṭhā upari ca pītasaddena suvaṇṇameva gahitanti daṭṭhabbaṃ.
Avayave cāyaṃ samudāyavohāro yathā “paṭo ḍaḍḍho, samuddo diṭṭho”ti ca.
Na taggamanasā satīti, tassaṃ gāviyaṃ gatamanā ṭhapitamanā na hontī, aññadatthu bhagavato thūpagatamanā eva samānāti attho.
“Tadaṅgamanasā satī”ti ca pāṭho, tadaṅge tassa bhagavato dhātuyā aṅge mano etissāti tadaṅgamanasā.
Evaṃbhūtā ahaṃ tadā tassā maggaṃ nāvekkhissanti dasseti.
Thūpaṃ apattamānasanti thūpaṃ cetiyaṃ asampattaajjhāsayaṃ, manasi bhavoti hi mānaso, ajjhāsayo manoratho.
“Thūpaṃ upagantvā pupphehi pūjessāmī”ti uppannamanorathassa asampuṇṇatāya evaṃ vuttaṃ.
Thūpaṃ cetiyaṃ pana pupphehi pūjanacittaṃ siddhameva, yena sā devaloke uppanna.
Tañcāhaṃ abhisañceyyanti tañce ahaṃ abhisañcineyyaṃ, pupphapūjanena hi puññaṃ ahaṃ thūpaṃ abhigantvā yathādhippāyaṃ pūjanena sammadeva cineyyaṃ upacineyyanti attho.
Bhiyyo nūna ito siyāti ito yathāladdhasampattitopi bhiyyo upari uttaritarā sampatti siyāti maññeti attho.
Tato sakko mātalipamukhassa devagaṇassa imāhi gāthāhi dhammaṃ desesi –
Appakampi kataṃ deyyaṃ, puññaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ.
Tathāgate vā sambuddhe, atha vā tassa sāvake.
“Tiṭṭhante nibbute cāpi, same citte samaṃ phalaṃ;
Yattha kāraṃ karitvāna, saggaṃ gacchanti dāyakā”ti.
Tattha pasādentoti pasanne karonto, ratanattaye saddhaṃ uppādentoti attho.

words: appakampi kataṃ deyyaṃ  puññaṃ hoti mahapphalaṃ
lines: Kammaphalanti deyyadhammassa anuḷārattepi khettasampattiyā ca cittasampattiyā ca uḷārassa puññakammassa phalaṃ passāti yojanā.
Appakampi kataṃ deyyaṃ, puññaṃ hoti mahapphalanti ettha katanti kāravasena sakkāravasena āyatane viniyuttaṃ.
Idāni yattha appakampi kataṃ puññaṃ mahapphalaṃ hoti, taṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā dassento “natthi citte pasannamhī”ti gāthamāha.
Cetopaṇidhihetu hīti attano cittassa sammadeva ṭhapananimittaṃ, attasammāpaṇidhānenāti attho.
